milestones.name: Baseline Audit & Preservation
milestones.notes: Preserved all Phase 15 checkpoints/results; 111/111 baseline pytest tests passed; measured CPU throughput (282-426 env_steps/s).

milestones.name: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL)
milestones.notes: Discrete-SAC+HER over 6 goal-conditioned neural skill MLPs + learned termination networks climbed from 0.0% (step=0, ent=1.7905) to 30.0% PickPlace success / 33.33% grasp at 12k steps vs 0.0%/0.0% Flat SAC+HER (12k) and 100.0%/96.67% Phase 14 500k baseline.

milestones.name: Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation (RGB-D)
milestones.notes: Oblique 128x128 RGB-D detector achieved 99.9%-100.0% detection rate, 14.81-15.55 mm 3D loc RMSE, 0.9983-0.9999 IoU; pure-vision SAC achieved 60% grasp / 15% PickPlace, pure-vision HRL achieved 25% grasp / 20% PickPlace without GT state.

milestones.name: Dynamic Object Manipulation
milestones.notes: Sliding-window tracker + predictive intercept achieved 100% linear, 95% sinusoidal, 95% step-disturbance, and 100% moving-target+cube PickPlace (vs 95% non-predictive linear).

milestones.name: Contact-Rich Manipulation (Peg-in-Hole)
milestones.notes: SCRIPTED_COMPLIANT controller improved assembly success from 50.0% -> 53.33% and reduced pos error (0.0532m -> 0.0468m) with 22 active jam recoveries; LEARNED_COMPLIANT_ASSEMBLY remains BLOCKED on prerequisite low-level RL grasp deficit (Phase 15 5k SAC: 3.33% grasp, 0% assembly).

milestones.name: Simulation Deployment Architecture
milestones.notes: Verified decoupled frozen checkpoint inference (zero import of train/HER), ObsPreprocessor, ActionPostprocessor, SafetyMonitor, and MetricsLogger via pytest.

milestones.name: Autonomous Task Execution (Vision + HRL + Safety)
milestones.notes: End-to-end 20-ep 2-object sorting using RGB-D perception + learned HRL + progress monitor achieved 25% Object-1 placement and 229 autonomous replans, with 0% full 2-object completion under 200-step budget.
